status: WRITTEN all-variable geometric boundary reduction for the single-scalar residual, UNREVIEWED; no finite threshold class
finding: For any rank2 P, h=((Tr_B P)_0,(Tr_A P)_0) satisfies ||h||²=Tr(P_A²)+Tr(P_B²)−2∈[0,4]. Lower endpoint h=0 iff both marginals are I4/2 and is paid by the tracezero dual theorem. Upper endpoint ||h||²=4 iff P=|v⟩⟨v|⊗Q or Q⊗|v⟩⟨v| with rank Q=2; the full original-source quadratic form at these product P is paid by the separately UNREVIEWED exact product-projector proof. Thus, conditional on both proofs, only 0<||h||²<4 remains for the scalar residual; no claim is made about its sign there.
upper_endpoint_proof: Local swap expansion gives 6−Tr(P_A²)−Tr(P_B²)=4 Tr[(P⊗P)Pminus_A Pminus_B]≥0. Equality forces the local-antisymmetric projector to annihilate every u⊗u with u in range P, so every such u has Schmidt rank1. A 2D subspace consisting wholly of product vectors has a common local factor, since the sum of two product vectors can have Schmidt rank1 only if their first or second factors are parallel. This gives the stated P forms. Conversely their marginal squared traces are 4 and 2.
limits: Exact boundary exclusion only, not a smallness criterion, a proof of interior scalar δ≥0, unrestricted T2/T3/Z2/q3, physical/q counterexample, sample, execution or novelty.
